name: solution-agent-harness
description: Operate declared remote workplaces and bounded research stages with durable receipts and event-driven waiting.

interface.shortDescription: Operate declared workplaces and bounded stages.
interface.longDescription: Provides one focused workflow across bounded stages, deterministic command results, selective artifact reading, and atomic artifact application. Waiting is handled by a deterministic sidecar; profile routing is disclosed only when relevant.
defaultPrompt: Run one bounded research stage and collect its evidence.
Store large evidence once, inspect a selection, then apply it atomically.
Run a short remote command with exact stdout, stderr, and exit status.
